consequence.statement: Status field differences are no longer detected by default for all resources; previously only custom resources had status fields ignored by default.
consequence.remediation: If you rely on detecting status field differences, set ignoreResourceStatusField to 'crd' in the argocd-cm ConfigMap's resource.compareoptions to preserve v2 behavior.

original.statement: By default, Argo CD's compare options to ignore the status field changed from applying to 'crd' (custom resources) to 'all' resource types, meaning status field differences are no longer detected unless explicitly configured.

decision.reason: [ev-c5faeec10a04] says the default compare option for ignoring the status field changed from `crd` to `all` resources, so status-field differences are no longer detected. It also says the v2 default can be kept by setting `ignoreResourceStatusField: crd` in argocd-cm resource.compareoptions. Nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. Diffing simply works differently under the new default, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind, and the statement and remediation match the evidence.
